summary: Blue Owl Technology Income Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a voluntary reduction of its aggregate committed debt capacity by $275M and $150M across two SPV facilities to reduce borrowing costs and align leverage with targets, effective July 2, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation event is present; the filing describes routine capital structure adjustments without stakeholder vote, premiums, or strategic transaction. The 8-K is a standard operational update.
